text_blocks.snippet: Jardiance (empagliflozin) can cause common mild side effects as well as rare, serious medical conditions.

list.snippet: Increased urination: Urinating more often or in larger amounts because the kidneys remove extra sugar through urine.
Urinary tract infections (UTIs): Symptoms include a burning sensation when you pee, a strong or urgent need to urinate, or cloudy/discolored urine.
Genital yeast infections: Fungal infections can happen around the vagina (itching, thick white discharge, burning) or around the penis and scrotum (redness, rash, irritation).
Increased thirst and mild dehydration: Feeling lightheaded, dizzy, or weak when standing up.

Diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA): A dangerous buildup of acid and ketones in the blood. This can happen even if your blood sugar is not very high. Symptoms include nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, unusual tiredness, and trouble breathing.
Severe dehydration and kidney problems: A sharp drop in body water and salt that can lead to sudden worsening of kidney function or low blood pressure.

Necrotizing fasciitis (Fournier’s gangrene): A rare but life-threatening bacterial infection of the tissue under the skin in the perineum (area between the anus and genitals) causing intense pain, swelling, redness, and fever.

Hypoglycemia (Low blood sugar): More likely if you take Jardiance along with other diabetes medications like insulin or sulfonylureas. Symptoms include shakiness, cold sweats, confusion, and a fast heartbeat.
Lower limb amputations: An increased risk of leg or foot sores, ulcers, or amputations, particularly if you have a history of vascular disease or previous foot ulcers.
Serious allergic reactions: Hives or swelling of the face, lips, and throat.

text_blocks.snippet: You can read more about safety warnings on the Jardiance Patient Information Page.
